title: Collaborative Canvas
label: Real-time collaboration
description: A shared drawing space where strokes and cursors travel together, in real time.
intro: A multi-user drawing application built around a React and Konva.js canvas, with a backend designed to keep every participant in sync.
highlights: Synchronized drawing and cursor interactions with SignalR WebSockets.
Used a Redis backplane to distribute low-latency messages across server instances.
Built REST APIs with ASP.NET Core and Entity Framework Core.
Batched drawing-log writes in background services and cached active sessions in Redis.
Containerized and deployed the application to Azure with automated CI/CD pipelines.

title: AI Rehabilitation Platform
label: Mountain Madness 2026 · Track winner
description: Real-time posture feedback and spoken guidance to make rehabilitation more approachable.
intro: Co-developed an AI-powered physical rehabilitation application that won multiple tracks at Mountain Madness 2026.
highlights: Analyzed live webcam coordinates with MediaPipe to provide real-time posture correction.
Combined VAPI and ElevenLabs for spoken feedback based on the user's exercise form.
Processed session movement data with Gemini to generate progress summaries.
Created downloadable PDF progress reports using jsPDF.

title: Architecture Diagram Generator
label: Aether Automation × SFU
description: From client data to import-ready diagrams, with less repetitive work in between.
intro: A capstone project with Aether Automation: a Spring Boot microservice that automates the architectural diagrams needed for client deliverables.
highlights: Built a secure pipeline for fetching client CRM records through Zoho Creator v2 REST APIs and OAuth 2.0.
Converted structured project data into import-ready Lucidchart XML with a GenAI-powered engine.
Co-developed a scalable microservice to replace manual diagram-generation workflows.
Used server-rendered Thymeleaf pages to improve search-engine visibility.
